test_title: PYST 5: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The lady was furious / to see that no one / were wearing masks / on the road near the shop.

options.text: on the road near the shop

solution:
The erroneous segment is** "were wearing masks"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of "were wearing masks" is incorrect instead of this we need to use "was wearing masks"
 
• In the given sentence, the subject for the verb "was" is "no one" which is singular in nature hence, we need to use a singular verb. So the correct verb is "was"
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• **The author provides** no documentary references to support her assertions. (The subject is "the author" hence, the verb should be singular i.e. "provides")
 
 

**So the correct sentence is-** *The lady was furious to see that no one **was wearing** masks on the road near the shop.*
